completed.title: Create isolated branch and baseline report
completed.summary: Created agent/gcp-multitopology-v3 from main@5697f91. Recorded environment, ran all pre-implementation test/lint/build gates, verified the promoted HydroCore-S checkpoint loads with a valid hash/schema/calibration match. No source files were changed before this record was written.

completed.title: Fix stale golden_scenario.json checksum in data/frozen/manifest.json
completed.summary: Regenerated the golden fixture in isolation and confirmed it was byte-identical to the committed file; only the manifest's recorded bytes/sha256 were stale. Corrected those two fields. pytest -q now 98/98 passing.

completed.title: Immutable experiment registry and run provenance
completed.summary: Added hydroswarm.training.ExperimentRegistry: append-only JSONL ledger with opened/closed events carrying every field the plan requires (run_id, parent_run_id, purpose, git commit + dirty-worktree status, architecture/variant, resolved config, seed, per-split manifest hashes, feature/target schema hashes, topology hashes, host/CPU/thread settings, peak RSS via getrusage, checkpoint hashes, selected checkpoint, selection metric, locked-test-opened flag, exit status). Duplicate run_ids and unknown parent_run_ids are rejected; resumed runs preserve lineage via ExperimentRegistry.lineage(). 9 new tests. Not yet wired into scripts/train.py (deferred to avoid touching Trainer internals in the same commit; will be wired when Bundle E smoke jobs launch real training runs).

completed.title: GCP-safe resumable job runner
completed.summary: Added hydroswarm.training.job_runner (launch/attach/poll/terminate/mark_finished): detached subprocess supervision with overlap rejection, a pre-launch disk guard, atomic status.json, and SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL termination, since this container has no systemd/tmux available. Added an opt-in Trainer.install_signal_handlers()/_shutdown_requested flag so a supervised training job actually stops cleanly (saves a resumable checkpoint) on SIGTERM instead of being killed mid-write, reusing the existing tested runtime-budget stop path. 7 new tests (6 job_runner + 1 SIGTERM end-to-end).

completed.title: Sharded lazy dataset backend
completed.summary: Added hydroswarm.training.ShardedScenarioDataset + write_shards: per-shard mmap-backed safetensors with a lightweight JSONL index (only metadata loaded at construction, tensors loaded lazily per __getitem__), per-shard + index-level sha256 verification, and a manifest_hash/stages_through surface identical to GovernedScenarioDataset. Verified as a real drop-in for Trainer with an actual training step (not just structural typing), verified worker-safe under DataLoader(num_workers=2) via fork, and verified pickle/deepcopy-safe (open shard handles excluded from __getstate__). 16 new tests. This is the stop-gate the plan requires before any 10k+ example corpus generation begins.

completed.title: Target/label audit tooling and sanity baselines
completed.summary: Added hydroswarm.training.label_audit: per-split target class histograms, missingness, impossible-label detection, duplicate/near-duplicate detection, finite-value validation, network/source balance, and cross_split_leakage(). Sanity baselines (random/majority/classical-prior) computed only for decision_splits, never for locked test. scripts/audit_labels.py ran against the real learning-v1 corpus (reports/results/v3/label-audit-learning-v1.json): 0 violations of any kind, classical-prior baseline 81-85% vs 25% random/majority. 12 new tests.

completed.title: Training-only normalization
completed.summary: Added NormalizationStats.save()/.load()/.fingerprint (governed JSON artifact + .sha256 sidecar) on top of the pre-existing fit()/transform(). scripts/fit_normalization.py's --split flag only accepts "train" and hard-fails if the manifest disagrees, so normalization cannot be fit on non-train data even by mistake. Documented all 19 node and 13 edge features as absolute vs topology-relative with units (NODE_FEATURE_SEMANTICS/EDGE_FEATURE_SEMANTICS), completeness enforced by a test. Ran against the real learning-v1 train split (800 examples); artifacts committed under reports/results/v3/normalization/. 13 new tests.

completed.title: Topology-balanced curriculum sampler
completed.summary: Added GroupBalancedSampler: every group (topology/network, source node, curriculum stage, or any composite) gets equal total sampling weight regardless of group size, so a large topology cannot dominate purely because it has more generated scenarios. Verified as a real DataLoader sampler and with an empirical 20k-draw statistical check. 9 new tests.

completed.title: Locked split and final-test policy
completed.summary: configs/evaluation_policy_v3.json: machine-readable split roles and the exact Stage 6/7 locked-final-test preconditions. hydroswarm.training.authorize_locked_final_test() enforces those preconditions as a real guard (SplitPolicyViolation) rather than leaving them as prose. docs/EVALUATION_V3_POLICY.md is the human-readable companion. 6 new tests. This closes Bundle A -- the stop-gate before variable-topology/large-corpus work.

completed.title: Topology-aware example metadata and graph-local labels
completed.summary: TopologyMetadata carries topology_hash, network_hash, node_ids, edge_ids, source_candidate_ids, hydraulic_state_hash, signature_library_hash, target/feature schema versions; validated on construction. ScenarioExample.topology is optional and fully backward compatible (full 163-test suite passed unchanged when added). resolve_source_node_id() maps a graph-local source_node index back to its real node ID. manifest_entry() is now topology-aware and shared between GovernedScenarioDataset and ShardedScenarioDataset. 19 new tests, later +1 regression test after fixing a real bug (see below).

completed.title: Per-topology signature registry
completed.summary: SignatureRegistry indexes existing SignatureCache artifacts by (topology_hash, hydraulic_regime_hash) via a small atomic JSON pointer index. register() rejects fit_split != "train". lookup() returns None on a miss or key-digest mismatch (cannot cross topology hashes); require() fails closed with a clear error. 8 new tests, including a real end-to-end SignatureBuilder simulation.

completed.title: Variable-size topology batch collation
completed.summary: Extended GraphSample/pad_graph_batch with node_scalar_features so travel_time/reservoir_reachability/demand_centrality/classical_prior/source_candidate_mask pad alongside node_features. collate_variable_topology() bridges ScenarioExample to this padded format; edge_index stays local per-example ([batch,2,edges]), never offset into a shared graph. 6 new tests, including a real HydroCore forward pass and a numerical proof that padding does not change a valid node's prediction versus running it unpadded alone.

completed.title: Scenario-specific hydraulic graph contexts
completed.summary: Confirmed (with a real WNTR network, not a fake) that HydraulicSimulator.state_hash() already changes when valve/pump state is mutated, so a per-scenario caller already avoids the plan's "single shared context" failure mode. Added ScenarioHydraulicContextKey (adds simulation_timestamp_seconds and state_estimator_config_hash, which state_hash() cannot see) and HydraulicContextCache with explicit hit/miss counting and fail-closed corruption handling. 8 new tests.

completed.title: Fix source_node index mapping to use full node_ids space
completed.summary: Found and fixed a real bug in the Task 1.1 work: source_node_id_for_local_index() indexed source_candidate_ids instead of node_ids. Every existing test happened to set them equal, masking the bug; a network with a genuine partial candidate subset would have silently resolved the wrong real-world node ID. Added a regression test with a strict subset that fails under the old implementation.

completed.title: Graph permutation augmentation and equivariance enforcement
completed.summary: permute_example() rearranges node ordering, remapping edge_index/source_node/node-indexed targets/topology metadata so real-world semantic identity survives (verified directly, not assumed). measure_equivariance() runs a model on original vs permuted input, maps back via the inverse permutation, and reports max logit difference, prediction agreement, and any non-equivariant input key. Empirical finding: HydroCore-S IS permutation-equivariant -- across 6 random permutations, source-logit differences stay under 1e-4 and predictions always agree, zero non-equivariant keys detected. 11 new tests. This completes Tasks 1.1-1.5, the plan's highest-priority technical change (variable-topology corpus architecture).

completed.title: Governed targets_v2 contract
completed.summary: TARGETS_V2 defines every Sentinel/Scout/Strategist/control target with a definition, unit, explicit masking rule, and source of truth (completeness enforced by a test). EventCause and NextStep enums match the plan's class lists exactly. Masking uses the same _mask suffix convention as input masks; validate_targets_v2() rejects unknown keys, orphaned masks, masks on non-maskable targets, and non-boolean masks. check_schema_version() fails clearly on a version mismatch. 11 new tests, including a governance guardrail asserting plan_validity's contract text names WNTR, not a neural prediction, as its source of truth.

completed.title: Governed OOD categories and behavior targets
completed.summary: OODCategory covers the plan's exact list (unseen topology/sensor layout, extreme demand, tank-state shift, valve/pump mismatch, roughness mismatch, severe missingness, frozen/drifting sensor, timing outside range, unsupported element/invalid calibration) as a concept distinct from the existing OODDetector's coarse severity level. OOD_CATEGORY_BEHAVIOR states expected controller behavior per category; its own constructor enforces that planning may never be permitted while calibration is invalid. topology_calibration_is_valid() and classify_abstention_outcome() (false abstention / unsafe non-abstention) operationalize the plan's governance and metrics requirements as real functions. 13 new tests.

completed.title: Multi-step incident trajectory serialization
completed.summary: TrajectoryState/FullTrajectory add a richer companion to the existing lightweight AgentTrajectory audit record, reusing the validated domain schemas (IncidentState, OperationalAction, PlanVerification) rather than duplicating their fields: observation history, candidates, remaining budgets, previous/selected actions, and verifier feedback. FullTrajectory verifies both contiguity and a hash chain between consecutive steps. 9 new tests, including a broken-hash-chain rejection.

completed.title: Complete Sentinel supervision (event_presence/event_cause/evidence_sufficiency/source_region)
completed.summary: Added EventType (CONTAMINATION/NORMAL/SENSOR_FAULT_ONLY) to the scenario generator using a negligible (not exactly zero) injection strength so NORMAL/SENSOR_FAULT_ONLY scenarios reuse the identical simulation path -- verified empirically (~1e-7 vs ~64 mg/L for a real injection). SENSOR_FAULT_ONLY forces a deterministic fault since the existing degradation is probabilistic. scenario_to_example() derives event_presence/event_cause/evidence_sufficiency/source_region deterministically and masks source_node/source_region/start_time/duration/relative_strength via targets_v2's _mask convention when event_presence is false. Found and fixed a real bug during verification (forced-fault logic smuggling finite values into missing-marked slots). 16 new tests total across both commits.

completed.title: Supervised Scout decision states
completed.summary: Discovered hydroswarm.sampling.active.rank_sample_locations already implemented nearly everything Task 2.3 asks for (candidate enumeration, EIG, candidate reduction, delay/cost/redundancy/accessibility, stop decision) and was already tested. Added the missing glue: build_signature_artifact_for_network() (real WNTR-backed signature fitting, cached) and generate_scout_label() (reindexes a scenario's observations onto the signature grid, computes a Bayesian posterior, calls the existing ranker). Deliberately not merged into ScenarioExample.targets since Scout supervision is sequential; documented as future TrajectoryState integration. 8 new tests against real WNTR simulation.

completed.title: Verified Strategist training labels
completed.summary: Discovered hydroswarm.planning.response.generate_response_plans already produces almost exactly the plan's bounded template list with a guaranteed no-response comparator, and prescreen_top_plans already bounds the exact-simulation budget. Added generate_strategist_labels() gluing these to the real PlanVerifier (WNTR) -- plan_validity is read only from the verifier's own decision, confirmed by a test that independently re-verifies every label. 7 new tests including a deliberately unsafe plan WNTR correctly rejects with real rejection codes. This closes Bundle B in full (Tasks 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6).

completed.title: Separate live/replay/demo/error data modes
completed.summary: Core P0 fix: fetchIncident() previously spread the entire demoIncident fixture, overwrote a handful of fields with real API data, and labeled the result source:'api', so a live-reachable incident would silently render frozen map/plans/evidence/benchmarks/explanation while claiming to be live. Replaced with four explicit RuntimeMode values (LIVE/REPLAY/DEMO_FALLBACK/ERROR) shown in the header. fetchIncident() now throws LiveViewIncompleteError naming exactly which fields the current API doesn't yet expose rather than silently substituting fixture content -- LIVE is never claimed for incomplete data. New IncidentUnavailableError/ERROR mode with a Retry button, distinct from total-outage DEMO_FALLBACK. 6 new tests including a real env-stubbed live-incident-configured path.

completed.title: Remove hard-coded identifiers; fix calibration language
completed.summary: Removed hard-coded node/plan IDs from OperationalMap's aria-label/screen-reader summary, EvidencePanel's Before/After titles, TopologyPage's aria-label, Overview's Why Plan B?/Review Plan B approval/Why was Plan A rejected? -- all now derived from incident data. New identifier-independence test renders the full app against a fixture with entirely different node/plan IDs/order and asserts none of the old hard-coded strings leak through (the plan's exact stated test). Replaced mislabeled 'calibrated candidate coverage {target}%' with separate conformal target / calibration validity / candidate-set size / measured coverage fields.

completed.title: Disable unwired controls with explicit reasons
completed.summary: Four buttons (Review Plan B approval, Review sample request, Export incident JSON, Verify hash chain) had no onClick handler at all. Disabled with explicit title reasons rather than appearing functional while doing nothing. Also replaced an unconditional 'Chain status: VALID' claim (no actual verification behind it) with an honest 'not independently verified by this console yet'.

completed.title: Render governed model evaluation and promotion evidence
completed.summary: ValidationPage/BenchmarkPage claimed 'NOT RUN' neural checkpoint evaluation and 'no trained checkpoint included' -- false; HydroCore-S hybrid is promoted at 96.0% top-1. Added public/model-governance.json, every value individually verified against the real governed reports/results/*.json (source file hashes recorded in the artifact), and ModelGovernanceTable rendering Model/Parameters/Top-1/ECE/Latency/Decision, with an honest 'not evaluated' for HydroCore-L rather than a fabricated number. 5 new tests.

completed.title: Operational UI visual regression coverage
completed.summary: Real Playwright/Chromium coverage: 1366x768 and 1920x1080 screenshots with committed baseline images, keyboard-only navigation, reduced-motion (toggle + emulated media), DEMO_FALLBACK banner, selected-plan sync, no horizontal overflow. Found and fixed real test flakiness: Overview's plan table sits behind the same Suspense boundary as lazy-loaded map/chart chunks, so `locator.count()` (which does not auto-wait) raced against chunk loading in a real browser. Verified stable across repeated runs.

completed.title: Safe failure-injection demonstrations
completed.summary: ?failure=<category> query parameter covering all nine plan-specified categories (missing_checkpoint, corrupt_checkpoint_hash, incompatible_feature_schema, corrupt_calibration, unknown_topology, wntr_timeout, incomplete_simulator_output, severe_sensor_dropout, no_valid_plan). Each renders ERROR mode with the exact, distinct reason named, never a false LIVE/VERIFIED state. 12 new unit tests plus one real-browser Playwright test. This completes Bundle C except Task 3.2 (full backend `/incidents/{id}/view` contract), which received a narrower interim treatment (fetchIncident documents and throws on exactly the fields it can't yet provide, rather than a full new endpoint) -- see follow-up.md.

completed.title: Architecture versioning and configurable classical-prior injection
completed.summary: Added ARCHITECTURE_VERSION, architecture_config(), verify_architecture_compatibility() (Task 4.0's explicit compatibility contract). Made the two previously-unconditional classical-prior injection paths (hidden-state feature, direct log-prior term on source logits) configurable via prior_mode (none/feature_only/logit_only/feature_and_logit, default reproduces the old behavior exactly). Both parameters exist regardless of mode -- zero checkpoint tensor shape change -- so the promoted HydroCore-S checkpoint reloads byte-identically; verify_architecture_compatibility() catches a prior_mode mismatch load_state_dict's shape check alone would miss. 11 new tests.

completed.title: Source-conditioned incident pooling
completed.summary: Made the incident-level heads' pooling (timing/duration/strength/evidence-sufficiency/uncertainty/OOD) configurable via incident_pooling (mean/latent/attention/source_conditioned, default "mean" exactly reproduces the prior masked-mean pool). attention/source_conditioned modes add new incident_query/incident_attention/incident_context_projection parameters only when selected -- default stays checkpoint-compatible. 17 new tests including permutation equivariance across all four modes.

completed.title: Dual hydraulic message channels
completed.summary: message_direction (forward_only/dual_gated, default "forward_only" exactly reproduces the original single-direction convolution). dual_gated adds a separately-parameterized upstream-diagnostic channel over the reversed edge direction (EdgeAwareGraphConv._aggregate(reverse=True), reusing the same edge features with source/target swapped rather than a separate reversed-edge-feature set), fused with a learned sigmoid gate (new DualChannelGraphConv). 15 new tests, including a direct proof the gate reduces exactly to the downstream-only update when driven to saturate, and permutation equivariance for both modes.

completed.title: Event classification and next-step advisory heads
completed.summary: Added event_presence_logits/event_cause_logits/next_step_logits, gated behind event_control_heads: bool = False (departs from 4.1-4.3's pattern since these are net-new parameters, not an existing pathway made configurable -- unconditional construction was tested and confirmed to break the promoted checkpoint's strict load, so it was gated instead). Wired event_cause (cross-entropy) and event_presence (binary cross-entropy) losses into compute_multitask_loss since corpus.py already emits those labels; next_step has no label generator yet. Deferred: inference-pipeline serialization and evaluation metrics, meaningful only once a trained event_control_heads=True variant exists. 12 new tests.

completed.title: Three configuration-controlled auxiliary objectives
completed.summary: Added masked sensor reconstruction, future concentration prediction, and travel-time prediction -- exactly the three the plan specifies, gated behind auxiliary_heads: bool = False (same net-new-parameter rationale as 4.4). Registered all three as governed targets_v2 targets under a new "auxiliary" category. Added AUXILIARY_TASK_DEFAULT_WEIGHT=0.1 applied by compute_multitask_loss by default (task_weights still overrides) so these auxiliary objectives don't compete on equal footing with primary heads by default, per "loss weights are explicit." Actual label generation deferred to Phase 5. 12 new tests.

completed.title: Non-authoritative plan consequence prescreening (Bundle D complete)
completed.summary: Added five *_proxy heads (exposure/pressure_risk/service_loss/containment_time/plan_regret) applied to the per-plan-query representation, gated behind consequence_prescreening_heads: bool = False. Registered as governed "strategist" targets alongside plan_value/consequence_vector/plan_validity, each explicitly documented non-authoritative and never replacing PlanVerifier's exact WNTR simulation. Wired into compute_multitask_loss (output name equals target name, same convention as plan_value). Deferred: label generation from real PlanVerifier output at corpus scale, and the ranking-quality/simulator-call-reduction evaluation harness Task 4.6 calls for -- both are Phase 5/6/7 work. 11 new tests. This completes Bundle D (Tasks 4.0-4.6): every new architecture flag verified to leave the promoted HydroCore-S checkpoint loadable at its default value; 349 backend tests, ruff clean, pyright clean.

completed.title: Generate the Cycle A smoke corpus across 2 genuine topologies
completed.summary: Added DatasetSplit.DEVELOPMENT_HOLDOUT, distinct from the locked-final-test TEST split, matching configs/evaluation_policy_v3.json's already-governed "development_holdout" role -- generating Cycle A's disposable dev-holdout under TEST would have made ordinary architecture-comparison iteration indistinguishable from opening the locked test. scripts/generate_cycle_a_corpus.py then generated 2,550 scenarios (1,750/250/250/300 train/validation/calibration/development_holdout) across the golden reference network and the independent branched-loop network (data/topology-transfer/branched-loop.inp) -- two genuinely different graph structures, closing a limitation scripts/prepare_training_corpus.py's own dataset-report.json had honestly flagged. Found and fixed a real bug while running this for the first time: label_audit._sensor_fault_prevalence assumed one shared node count across an entire split, which breaks the moment two topologies with different junction counts are mixed. Generated in ~3 minutes; ~4.5MB of manifests/signatures/reports committed, ~55MB of regenerable scenario/tensor binaries gitignored.

completed.title: Wire Trainer for variable-topology batches; fix two real loss-masking/shape bugs
completed.summary: Trainer hardcoded collate_scenarios (plain torch.stack), which cannot batch examples with different node counts; added an optional collate_fn parameter (default unchanged) so collate_variable_topology can be selected. Preparing the first real training run against Cycle A then surfaced two further real bugs neither synthetic test fixtures nor Bundle B's schema work had caught: compute_multitask_loss never read any targets_v2 f"{task}_mask" companion, so corpus.py's placeholder 0 labels for NORMAL/SENSOR_FAULT_ONLY scenarios (~30% of Cycle A) were silently trained against as real labels -- fixed via a new _apply_target_mask helper, and source_region (a real head, a real corpus target, zero prior loss wiring) was connected for the first time; and HydroCore.evidence_head's output was never squeezed ([batch,1] vs. the real [batch] target), crashing the first real forward-pass-into-loss combination. 6 new regression tests across the three fixes.

completed.title: Smoke/failure screening for E0, E3, E4, and E9 (Bundle E complete)
completed.summary: scripts/run_architecture_smoke_jobs.py ran 6 real training configurations (E0 baseline, E3 source_conditioned pooling, E4 dual_gated message channels, and 3 of E9's 4 internal prior/fusion comparisons) against a 200-train/50-validation Cycle A subset: an explicit pre-training gradient-flow check via task_gradient_norms, a real 2-epoch Trainer.fit(), a resume check (one more epoch from the exported checkpoint), and a checkpoint-reload/verify_architecture_compatibility check. All six passed every check -- zero NaNs, zero zero-gradient tasks, zero failed resumes, validation loss decreased in every case. Full sweep ~2m24s CPU time. Real ExperimentRegistry provenance recorded (experiments/registry/bundle-e-smoke.jsonl). This completes Bundle E (Cycle A generation + Stage 1 architecture smoke screening): 355 backend tests, ruff clean, pyright clean, promoted checkpoint verified loadable throughout.

completed.title: Cycle B corpus generation (Bundle F data landing)
completed.summary: scripts/generate_cycle_b_corpus.py generated 12,750 scenarios across 3 training topologies (golden-reference, branched-loop, loop-grid) plus 800 development-OOD holdout examples (UNSEEN_TOPOLOGY, SEVERE_MISSINGNESS) against a 4th topology (coastal-branch), split 9000/1000/1000/1750 train/validation/calibration/development_holdout. Label audit clean across every split (0 duplicate IDs, 0 finite-value violations, 0 impossible labels). Generation took ~15.5 minutes. Documented, non-blocking limitations recorded in dataset-report.json (split counts toward low-mid end of plan ranges; only 2 of ~10 OOD categories generated this pass; no ood_class per-example target yet; hard-negative pairs not attempted this pass).

completed.title: Complete incident-view API contract (backend + frontend)
completed.summary: Implemented GET /api/incidents/{incident_id}/view end to end, closing the item that previously had only an interim treatment. Backend: IncidentView Pydantic schema (all extra=forbid) covering every field the plan lists -- provenance hashes/versions, controller state, full map topology sourced only from imported-network metadata, sensor health, sample recommendation, evidence history, plans with verifications, audit-ledger-derived selected plan vs. strategist-recommended plan, per-plan counterfactual consequences, all 7 grounded explanation intents, audit events, runtime metrics. Fails closed (409 pre-analysis, 503 on incomplete topology metadata) rather than ever backing the response with DEMO_FALLBACK content. 4 new backend contract tests drive a real HybridInferencePipeline through the actual HTTP API. Frontend: viewFromApi() replaces the old LiveViewIncompleteError stub with a real mapping from the live response; IncidentView/demoFixture/PlanTable extended to match the backend schema field-for-field. Full pytest/ruff/pyright/eslint/tsc-build/vitest/playwright all green.

completed.title: Fix Counterfactuals.tsx hard-coded plan positions (Task 3.3 regression)
completed.summary: Found while scoping Task 8.1: Counterfactuals.tsx hard-coded plans[0]/plans[1] as literal PLAN A/PLAN B branches and hard-coded the recommended-branch styling to whichever was named PLAN B -- exactly what Task 3.3 required removing (hard-coded recommended branch; ensure plan order can change without breaking the UI), missed at the time and uncovered by zero prior tests (identifier-independence check looked for Plan A/Plan B, case-sensitive, never matching this all-caps text). Real impact: crashes on any incident with fewer than 2 plans, silently drops any 3rd+ plan, mislabels which branch is recommended whenever plan order/naming differs from the original demo fixture -- plausible now that the live /view endpoint returns plans in insertion order, not a fixed A/B pair. Fixed to derive every branch from the real plans array keyed by plan id, with recommended styling from plan.status. Added 5 regression tests; regenerated and visually reviewed the 2 committed screenshot baselines.

completed.title: Complete architecture screening (E0-E8)
completed.summary: All 9 configurations trained successfully against the full Cycle B corpus, zero failures. Predeclared score ranking: E2 (0.7794) > E0 (0.7783) > E1 (0.7768) > E3 (0.7742) > E6 (0.7727) > E4 (0.7709) > E8 (0.7696) > E7 (0.7680) > E5 (0.7647). Top four scores span only 0.0052 -- noise-level at one seed/4 epochs. E7 (source-only) and E8 (full-multitask), the required diagnostic pair, both scored below baseline. Total wall time 12,401s (~3h27m).

completed.title: Launch finalist training script (E2/E0/E1, 2 seeds each)
completed.summary: Wrote and smoke-tested scripts/run_stage3_finalist_training.py: trains the top 3 Stage 2 finalists (selected mechanically from the predeclared score) with 2 seeds each to early stopping or a 2h ceiling, fits calibration per checkpoint on the calibration split only, evaluates on validation/development_holdout/both OOD-holdout categories. Verified via a scratch 1-epoch smoke run before launching the real 6-run background job. Job launched and running at handoff time; see training-jobs.md.

completed.title: Complete finalist training and record selection recommendation
completed.summary: All 6 finalist/seed runs completed successfully, zero failures, ~12.0h wall time. Recommends E1 (prior_mode=feature_only): best out-of-distribution generalization to an unseen topology (top1 0.530 vs E2 winner-on-in-distribution-metrics 0.495, calibrated coverage 0.848 vs 0.823), trading under 1 percentage point of in-distribution accuracy to E2. Recorded as a recommendation for human review in reports/results/v3/finalist-selection-recommendation.md, not an autonomous final selection -- Stage 4 controls, Stage 5, full-trajectory eval, and abstention recording all remain before a true Stage 6 final selection.

completed.title: Compute classical-only baseline; launch no-adapter/HydroMono control training
completed.summary: Discovered HydroMono-S and no-adapter HydroCore-S are architecturally identical in this codebase (bit-identical state dicts verified directly from the same seed) -- training both would be duplicate compute, so only one is trained. Current-architecture baseline is E0, already trained in Stage 3. Classical-only baseline computed directly from the corpus precomputed classical_prior feature, no training needed (val top1 0.625, dev_holdout 0.639, OOD-unseen-topology only 0.236 -- more than double worse than any neural finalist under that shift). Launched the one distinguishable control (no-adapter HydroCore-S, 2 seeds, Stage 3-identical budget) as a background job.
